name: hologram-logo-motion
description: Remotion project for the Hologram promo end-card logo motion

scripts.render:slide: remotion render LogoSlide out/slide-seq --sequence --image-format=png && node scripts/stitch.mjs out/slide-seq out/logo-slide.mp4
scripts.render:fill: remotion render LogoFill out/fill-seq --sequence --image-format=png && node scripts/stitch.mjs out/fill-seq out/logo-fill.mp4
